description: Trade Volume Timeseries. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/trade-volume-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching token trade volume over time. Track buy and sell volumes or counts hourly or daily to analyze trading trends.

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/trade-volume-ts.

projection.description: The metric to aggregate per time bucket. One of: 'sellVolumeUsd', 'buyVolumeUsd', 'sellCount', 'buyCount'.

timeEnd.description: End of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Required.

timeStart.description: Start of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Required.

unit.description: Time bucket size — either 'HOUR' or 'DAY'. Determines the granularity of returned data points.

name: get-token-trade-volume-history
title: Trade Volume Timeseries
